_comment: Overlay applied by tools/make_handin.py on config/parameters.json: generic vehicle description.

aero.cross_track_area_note: Frontal area (Level 1), used for drag with longitudinal_stiffness.drag_coeff; the lift model shares it but stays zero while lift_coeff = 0.
aero.cross_track_area_derived_from: Generic frontal area of a race car of touring-car size (Trzesniowski 2019).

vehicle.mass_note: Level 1 vehicle mass; corner weights entered on the setup sheet (Level 2) replace it per session.

wheel_loads.tyre_dynamic_radius_note: Level 1 estimate: static tyre circumference / (2 pi). Used only as the unsprung transfer arm.
wheel_loads.roll_centre_note: Level 1 estimate of the roll-centre height. Used for the geometric sprung lateral-transfer term only; the elastic part is already in the measured pushrod force and must not be added twice.
wheel_loads.aero_front_fraction_note: Level 1 estimate of the front share of the aero load, used only when the aero load is split to the axles.

longitudinal_stiffness.drag_coeff_note: Level 1, literature: with vehicle.aero.cross_track_area_m2 the longitudinal balance gains 0.5 rho c_D A v^2.
longitudinal_stiffness.drag_coeff_derived_from: Order of magnitude of production-based GT race cars (Katz 1995).
